title: JOVE ICE: Intent Guided Cloud Edge Device Collaboration for AI Glasses
abstract: arXiv:2611.33735v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and LLM based agents have expanded the capabilities of AI glasses, enabling egocentric visual question answering, memory retrieval, and proactive assistance. These applications involve diverse inputs, including speech, images, and video, and range from simple device control to complex visual reasoning, posing challenges for efficient computation and communication. While video centric capabilities have received considerable attention, simple text based and device executable tasks remain underexplored despite their prevalence in daily interactions. Efficiently supporting diverse workloads within a unified assistant remains an open challenge. We propose JOVE ICE, an intent guided cloud, edge, and device collaborative framework that routes requests among AI glasses, a paired smartphone, and cloud servers according to user intent. translated_title: JOVE ICE：面向AI眼镜的意图引导云边端协同框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）及基于LLM的智能体的最新进展扩展了AI眼镜的能力，使其能够实现第一视角视觉问答、记忆检索和主动辅助。这些应用涉及语音、图像和视频等多样化输入，任务范围从简单的设备控制到复杂的视觉推理，为高效计算与通信带来了挑战。尽管以视频为中心的能力受到了广泛关注，但简单的基于文本和设备可直接执行的任务在日常交互中十分普遍，却仍未得到充分探索。如何在统一的智能助手中高效支持多样化工作负载，仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。我们提出了JOVE ICE，这是一个意图引导的云、边、端协同框架，能够根据用户意图在AI眼镜、配对的智能手机和云服务器之间路由请求。JOVE ICE将分层意图分类与动态……（摘要截断）相结合。
tldr: 提出了JOVE ICE——一个根据用户意图在AI眼镜、智能手机与云服务器之间智能路由请求的云边端协同框架，以高效支持从简单设备控制到复杂视觉推理的多样化AI眼镜工作负载。
en_tdlr: JOVE ICE is an intent-guided cloud-edge-device collaborative framework that routes requests among AI glasses, paired smartphones, and cloud servers according to user intent, enabling efficient support for diverse workloads ranging from simple device control to complex visual reasoning.
